items.name: chimahon
items.description: Mihon immersion fork with native dictionary lookup (Yomitan), Mokuro manga and anime support, Novel EPUB reader, and instant Anki card mining.

items.name: Jiten
items.description: A free, open-source platform for Japanese immersion learners. Jiten offers detailed statistics for thousands of Japanese media such as character count and difficulty, pre-built anki decks, vocabulary lists, frequency lists, user coverage, and more.

items.name: monosai
items.description: A Japanese reading app for beginners with Anki word recognition, story generation and TTS.

items.name: GameSentenceMiner
items.description: An immersion toolkit for learning Languages through games and other visual media.

items.name: anki_miner
items.description: Automated Japanese vocabulary mining from media.

items.name: SubMiner
items.description: Integrates Yomitan with MPV - featuring one click Anki mining, realtime subtitle annotations, and immersion tracking. No browser or texthooker required

items.name: jp-sentences-to-anki
items.description: Turn your i+1 Japanese sentences into an Anki deck with VOICEVOX audio

items.name: anki_miner_android
items.description: Automated Japanese vocabulary mining from media on Android.

items.name: anki-japanese-template
items.description: A clean, modern Japanese sentence-mining note type designed for Anki / AnkiDroid.

items.name: evstuff
items.description: General sandbox of half-baked things, relating mostly to Anki, Japanese, and InDesign.

items.name: origa
items.description: Learn Japanese in your own language - vocabulary, kanji, grammar & 200K+ native phrases. JLPT prep, offline-first, FSRS spaced repetition. Rust + Tauri.

items.name: kikubridge
items.description: Converts premade Japanese Anki decks into Kiku notes and keeps a headless Anki collection in sync through AnkiConnect

items.name: playtranslate
items.description: Translate Japanese game text in real time on Android with instant and live modes, word lookup, and export to Anki for language learning.

items.name: cards
items.description: Utilities for creating, managing, and updating Japanese Anki cards

items.name: yochimu
items.description: ⛩ Yochimu, Japanese for 'prophetic dream,' aids in comfortable text comprehension by extracting words, providing definitions, translations, and example sentences from Japanese text files, and facilitating deck creation for learning via SRS tools like Anki.
